title: seqeralabs/nf-proteindesign - Proteina-Complexa samplesheet schema
description: Schema for validating samplesheets when --protein_design_tool=complexa. Each row specifies a target PDB, pipeline config YAML, and target sequence.

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample ID must be alphanumeric with underscores or hyphens only

target_pdb.errorMessage: Target PDB must be a valid file path ending in .pdb or .cif

pipeline_config.errorMessage: Pipeline config must be a valid file path ending in .yaml or .yml

target_sequence.errorMessage: Target sequence must be a valid file path to a FASTA file

target_msa.errorMessage: Target MSA must be a valid file path to a pre-computed MSA file

target_template.errorMessage: Target template must be a valid file path to a PDB or CIF file
